title: Static Clothed Torso and Eight Leg Spider Folk
description: One wholly newly authored static spider-folk fantasy character. A complete low front arachnid body narrows through a continuous waist into a broad high rounded abdomen, while eight whole high-arched tapering jointed legs fan into separate finite ground tips. A newly drawn continuous fully covered upright torso, neck and human-like head rises from the front body; two complete bent sleeved arms end in blunt stylized hands. Hair and tunic roles are integral face regions; small embedded eyes and a finite blunt nose define the adult-like face. The complete radial arachnid leg/waist/abdomen and upright covered body organization is not a horse with more legs, a catalogue spider with a head attached, or an extracted centaur torso. Every body station, limb path and facial placement is new numeric geometry with no imported old meshes. Three opaque matte PBR roles, metres Z up, whole horizontal envelope centred on actual ground tips, one character prop zero scenes. No weapons, exposed intimate anatomy or extra costume props. Fictional fixed art only: no biological species, anatomical fidelity, gait, balance, poison, strength, rigging, animation, deformation, interaction, collision or safety capability.
